# London Tech

London Tech is a London technology store with a catalogue covering phones, computers, tablets, audio, watches, gaming, accessories and related products.

Canonical website: https://london-tech.vercel.app/
Store information: https://london-tech.vercel.app/collections/visit/
Detailed catalogue guide: https://london-tech.vercel.app/llms-full.txt

- All technology and accessories: https://london-tech.vercel.app/collections/shop/

## Accuracy

The catalogue is a product-information prototype. It does not establish current stock, selling price, warranty, delivery or collection terms. Confirmed store address, public contact details and opening hours will be added to the store information page.
